gamma_ray.fact_ray: 6 facts: 6 π Moderate. Each is written beside its evidence above.

configs.what: Conversational AI with its documented defaults.
A deployment connected to the operator's own CRM, contact-centre or messaging platforms; the connection is built per deployment.

facts.label: It executes actions itself
facts.fact: The product page says, in one vendor sentence with no named customer, that data changes, payments, orders and service subscriptions are completed end-to-end by the AI with no agent stepping in; it does not say through which systems, and the connected-systems configuration is the scan's inference.
facts.quote: completed end-to-end by the AI, with no need for an agent

facts.label: The agent handles routine tasks; the person is consulted on exceptions
facts.fact: The FAQ says requests that follow a predictable flow are handled autonomously, and that a conversation needing human intervention passes to an available agent with its context (the FAQ text is in the product page's script file, captured as it loads).
facts.quote: When a conversation reaches a point that requires human intervention

facts.label: It works across several domains or systems
facts.fact: The product page says Conversational AI connects with CRM, contact-centre (CCaaS) and messaging platforms; it names these categories only, and no named connector or integration list was found in the sources.
facts.quote: Conversational AI connects with every major CRM, CCaaS, and messaging platform

facts.label: Its purpose and permitted tasks are stated in writing
facts.fact: The FAQ lists the types of request the assistant handles on its own.
facts.quote: account management, payments, order tracking, appointment scheduling, data updates

facts.label: The data it uses is described
facts.fact: The service terms define Customer Data as what a business provides to the service, including assistant configurations, frequent questions' answers and messages, and the data of its end users.
facts.quote: Virtual Employee configurations, frequent questions’ answers, text messages

help.label: Our hypothesis, not their claim. Built from public pages only; nothing of theirs was tested.
help.pitch: RiskMandate would measure, for one real deployment of Automaise's agents, what each agent was asked to do (its mandate), what its credentials and connections actually let it reach (its grant), and the difference between the two (the gap), and keep that as a written record. It is read-only: never in the request path.
